title: Clinical-Genomic Risk Group Classification of Suspicious Lesions on Prostate Multiparametric-MRI
summary: Adaptive-LASSO and logistic models used prostate MRI and clinical features to distinguish low-risk biopsy lesions in a selected trial-derived cohort. The best reported AUC was 0.95.
ai_technology: Habitat-risk segmentation and radiomics with adaptive-LASSO/logistic models classified low-risk prostate lesions from pre-biopsy clinical/MRI features; 231 cores/78 men and bootstrap optimism correction, best AUC .95. Small selected trial-derived cohort, no external validation.
organization: University of Miami Miller School of Medicine; Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center; University of Miami

evidence.tested: The analysis included 231 biopsy cores from 78 men and used bootstrap correction for model optimism.
evidence.unknown: A small selected cohort and internal resampling limit what the result establishes about other patients.
evidence.ai_role: Habitat-risk segmentation and radiomics with adaptive-LASSO/logistic models classified low-risk prostate lesions from pre-biopsy clinical/MRI features; 231 cores/78 men and bootstrap optimism correction, best AUC .95. Small selected trial-derived cohort, no external validation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
